critiques.claim: Nonfunctional requirements are largely constraints on implementation technology and QoS constraints (citing ISO 25010:2011).
critiques.critique: The 2011 standard has been superseded by ISO/IEC 25010:2023 (9-characteristic quality model). Furthermore, vague adjectives like 'scalable' or 'fast' must be operationalized into Quality Attribute Scenarios to become architecturally significant.
critiques.nuance: SWEBOK's intent to separate performance bounds from functionality remains crucial for architectural design.

extensions.title: Topic 9.7 Quality Attribute Scenarios
extensions.summary: Concrete SEI scenario templates (Source, Stimulus, Artifact, Environment, Response, Measure).

fieldContext.note: ISO 25010:2023 characteristics: Functional Suitability, Performance Efficiency, Compatibility, Interaction Capability, Reliability, Security, Maintainability, Flexibility, Safety.
